actual_account_null_cause: No ledger bundle in supplied readiness request; current broker account access is outside this source-only subtask.

minimum_original_resources.resource: Prospective runtime observation exports from one identified account and fixed signal configuration
minimum_original_resources.format: HARPOON_OBSERVATION_EXPORT_1; preferably snapshot descriptor + all pinned pages and stream manifest
requirements: Original market timestamps and receipt timestamps retained
Complete snapshot prefix and valid frame/chain hashes
Stock/ETF features, quote, bars, SPY benchmark and observed session calendar
Explicit local selection grid fixed before relevant observation selection
Mature label quotes observed at the configured horizon with original availability
All labels available before model availability
One row per asset/session; repeated intraday decisions cannot manufacture independent sessions
Current model age limits respected

minimum_original_resources.resource: Original fixed Ridge/SVR model JSON bytes and causal data/protocol lineage
requirements: Model origin observed, panel data_hash and feature/horizon contracts match
Both models available strictly before measured decisions
Model source JSON bytes retained separately from semantic hashes
Existing search journal and exact registered three-policy measurement receipt; no counter reset

minimum_original_resources.resource: Account ledger history covering the same measured account and interval
requirements: At least two reconciled comparable account observations
Cash, inventory, activities, external flows and open positions included
All pages have one ledger_integrity and complete total_records without gaps
Closed economic prefix covers the entire comparison period

minimum_original_resources.resource: Original cost receipt and broker accrual documentation for that same account/period
requirements: All four declared operating-cost categories covered
Original document content, SHA-256 and explicit field bindings support accrual coverage
Applicable unreported commissions, exchange/clearing/regulatory/financing/borrow/other costs included or explicit documented zero
External charges reconciled once and their period total bound to comparison execution_model

minimum_original_resources.resource: Registered fixed-model three-policy comparison on original observations with justified execution assumptions
requirements: C0, RIDGE and SVR use the same capital, event horizon and admissible constraints
Complete original market-source refs; modeled quotes bound to observed receipt availability
Executable quantity, fees and delays cannot be inferred from missing depth
Comparison remains a modeled counterfactual even when source observations are genuine

implemented_steps.source: xxx/coordinator.ts configureLanes: quant-prospective-observations; accounting every 60000 ms when quant enabled

implemented_steps.step: Bounded durable observations with pinned snapshot paging
Bounded account history with verifiable complete-page export
Causal panel with original availability and labels
Three-policy funded comparison and numerical predictor replay

concrete_integration_gap.evidence: The runtime exposes authenticated observation snapshot/page and accounting-history endpoints. tools/export_observation_snapshot.cjs only assembles/verifies already-downloaded local files. No production tool in tools/ retrieves the whole authenticated evidence bundle; guide requires manual pagination.
concrete_integration_gap.bounded_remediation: A one-shot authenticated GET-only collector may download health/identity, pinned observation pages, and a consistent ledger page set; bind expected account and version; write original bytes with SHA-256; verify via existing readers; generate explicit missing-resource report. No model fitting, trade submission, cost fabrication, or automatic score promotion.
operational_cases: Bound bytes/pages/time/retries and private credential handling
Reject mixed ledger revisions; bounded restart rather than unbounded retries
Preserve completed source bytes if a later page fails; do not label partial bundle complete
Return unknown costs as null, even if account/market export succeeds
concrete_integration_gap.existing_ledger_limit: exportHistory pins a state during one request and rejects revision changes, but there is no cross-request immutable ledger snapshot. Consistent multi-page export can require a bounded restart when the 60-second capture advances the revision.

scope_limits: No production instance inspected by this subtask
No new financial trial, fitting, broker request or external order
Existing synthetic engineering comparison was reexecuted only as part of verifying the prior blocked gate
Source hashes prove local consistency, not independent market or training provenance
